notes.title: Going free!
notes.notes: Hi everyone, sorry for changing my mind so soon after release. I was just working on this game for fun on the side and it was a mistake to not make it free, I know it still has some bugs; especially in the battle system! The game will go free on the 23rd. MAKE SURE TO REQUEST A REFUND if you are still eligible according to the steam guidelines so you can get your money back!
